bullets.text: Windows 11 Insider Preview Released - New build 26220.7535 offers features for Dev & Beta Channels, enhancing accessibility with Copilot.
Xbox Developer_Direct Returns - Celebrate Xbox's 25th anniversary with insights into upcoming games on January 22.
Enhanced Cyber Resilience Services - New proactive services from **Microsoft** Incident Response help organizations prepare for cyber incidents.
Phishing Attack Insights - **Microsoft** reveals how complex routing enables phishing actors to spoof domains effectively.
Introducing Defender Experts Suite - **Microsoft** launches a new security offering to combat advanced cyberthreats with expert-led services.
